title: Burglary
grade_or_penalty: 3rd degree; 2nd degree if the actor purposely, knowingly or recklessly inflicts, attempts or threatens bodily injury, or is armed with explosives or a deadly weapon
key_points: Entering a research facility, structure or secured part of it, or surreptitiously remaining there, with purpose to commit an offense inside.
Trespassing in utility company property with purpose to commit an offense is included.
elements: The suspect entered (or surreptitiously remained in) a research facility, structure, or separately secured part of a structure
The suspect had no license or privilege to be there
The suspect intended to commit an offense inside
For 2nd degree: purposely, knowingly or recklessly inflicted, attempted or threatened bodily injury, OR was armed with explosives or a deadly weapon

subsections.label: a(1)
subsections.text: Enters a research facility, structure or separately secured part of one, with purpose to commit an offense inside

subsections.label: a(2)
subsections.text: Surreptitiously remains there, knowing he is not licensed to, with purpose to commit an offense

subsections.label: a(3)
subsections.text: Trespasses in or on utility company property with purpose to commit an offense

subsections.label: b
subsections.text: 2nd degree if the actor purposely, knowingly or recklessly inflicts, attempts or threatens bodily injury, or is armed with explosives or a deadly weapon
